title: Moving a Small Business Electricity Supply Agreement to a New Site: Recording Rule and Care System Tool
content:
When a business relocates, a Small Business Electricity Supply agreement whose plan allows site transfers is moved to another commercial site of the same business for the remainder of its term, keeping its plan, contract rate and contract end date. The transfer takes effect on the new site's next scheduled meter read date, and one site transfer fee is billed on the agreement with the new site recorded on it, in the amount of the site transfer fee worked out for that move.

The relocation of an agreement that rolled over to month-to-month is not recorded until the agreement again shows a fixed term, with a term length, a contract end date and a renewal election accepted on the day its new term began.

## Business effect

The agreement is listed at the new site from the date the move takes effect, with its plan, rate and contract end date unchanged, and a site transfer fee line with the new site appears on the agreement's bill. The business sees the agreement at the new site and the transfer fee on its next statement.

## Tool: `transfer_agreement_site_58988442`

**Use and capability.** Moves a small business electricity agreement to another site of the same business when the business relocates, and bills the site transfer fee. The agreement keeps its agreement number, plan, rate and contract end date; its supplied site becomes the new site and the date the move takes effect is recorded on it. A site transfer fee line is added to the agreement's bill with the new site, the fee amount and today's posting date.

**How it is invoked.** This is an agent-side tool. The agent unlocks `transfer_agreement_site_58988442` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `bizpower_agreement_id` | the agreement number of the small business electricity agreement being moved, as shown on the agreement record returned by the agreement lookup | identifier |
| `new_premise_id` | the reference number of the business's new site, as shown on that site's record returned by the site lookup | identifier |
| `site_transfer_date` | the date the move takes effect at the new site | calendar date, YYYY-MM-DD |
| `transfer_fee_usd` | the site transfer fee in USD | positive number with 2 decimal places, already rounded half up to the cent; 0.00 when no fee is billed |

**Return.** A receipt with `agreement_id` (the agreement moved), `new_site_id` (the site now supplied), `effective_on` (YYYY-MM-DD date the move takes effect), `fee_line_id` (the transfer fee line's reference), `fee_usd` (the fee billed, positive, 2 decimals) and `posted_on` (YYYY-MM-DD posting date of the fee). A receipt carrying a `fee_line_id` means the move and its fee are recorded.
